desc: Implement full solution: split p into A,B,C; KMP occurrence lists for each nonempty segment (reporting overlapping matches); build nextC and bestAend helpers; iterate over B occurrences to minimize C_end - A_start; return min or -1.
Handle edge cases: pattern "**" -> 0, empty A/B/C semantics (free start/end), occurrence bounds up to n, non-overlap thresholds, no-valid-match sentinel.
Validate against the 4 provided examples and randomized brute-force on small strings.
Verify sample 2 correctly rejects overlapping B/C segments (nextC[b+lb] = INF when C starts before B ends) yielding -1.
